About

I work in real production systems — the kind where reliability matters and decisions have consequences.

Over the past decade, I’ve worked through major shifts in technology: from large legacy systems to virtualization, containerization, infrastructure as code, and now into AI-driven environments. Tools change quickly — thinking habits last much longer.

When I enter a complex environment, I prioritize stabilization: assess impact, restore service, identify root cause, and strengthen the system to prevent recurrence. Every incident is an opportunity to strengthen the system — through clear communication, documentation, and proactive improvement.

I’m known for patience, systems-level framing, and bringing structure to complex problems — helping teams step back, connect ideas, and see the bigger picture when complexity starts to cloud judgment.

Mentorship

I mentor engineers stepping into more responsibility around workflows, deployments, and production systems.

If you’re moving from “I can code” to “I can operate,” mentorship can be the difference between guessing and reasoning. My approach is practical and systems-first: clarify mental models, reduce tool anxiety, and build calm confidence in real environments.

I’m exploring a small, live cohort focused on production workflow clarity and systems thinking.

This is intentionally small. The goal is not to grind tools — it’s to build mental models that help you reason clearly about CI/CD, deployments, and production systems end-to-end.
